items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Dieser Bußgeldbescheid wird rechtskräftig und vollstreckbar, wenn Sie nicht innerhalb von zwei Wochen nach Zustellung schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der oben bezeichneten Verwaltungsbehörde Einspruch einlegen.
items.computation: This is a formal service (Zustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO) — the scanned envelope shows 'zugestellt am 17.09.2026', so this actual delivery date is the anchor, not the ordinary 3/4-day deemed-delivery fiction for authority letters. Counting under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB (via § 43 Abs. 1 StPO/§ 110 OWiG): the day of delivery, Thu 17.09.2026, is not counted; the period starts 18.09.2026. Two weeks (§ 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB) later ends Thu 01.10.2026. That day is a normal business day in Bayern (not a weekend or holiday), so no shift is needed. The objection must reach the Bußgeldstelle by this date.

items.title: Pay the total fine (Geldbuße, Gebühr, Auslagen)
items.quote: Bitte zahlen Sie den Gesamtbetrag spätestens zwei Wochen nach Rechtskraft unter Angabe des Aktenzeichens auf das unten genannte Konto.
items.computation: The payment period runs from 'Rechtskraft' (when the notice becomes final), not from a fixed date. If no Einspruch is filed by the objection deadline of 01.10.2026, the notice becomes rechtskräftig the following day, 02.10.2026. Counting two weeks from there under §§ 187, 188 BGB: the day after Rechtskraft (03.10.2026) starts the period, which ends two weeks later on Fri 16.10.2026 — a normal business day, so no shift is needed. This date assumes no Einspruch is filed; if one is filed, this payment obligation does not arise on this timeline.

warnings: The payment due date (2026-10-16) is only correct if no Einspruch is filed by 2026-10-01; filing an objection suspends this payment obligation and the case would instead go to court.

Page 2 is a photocopy of the delivery envelope showing the postal worker's handwritten 'zugestellt am 17.09.2026' — this formal Zustellungsurkunde date, not the ordinary deemed-delivery rule, was used to compute the Einspruch deadline; if the true service date differs, both computed dates would shift accordingly.

The IBAN (DE52 7115 0000 0000 0077 07, BLZ 71150000) is a validly formatted German IBAN consistent with the stated 'Sparkasse Musterau' and BIC BYLADEM1MUS, but this only checks the format, not true ownership — verify it matches prior official correspondence before paying.
